title: Normal operating envelope
content: Rated flow 20-120 m3/h, discharge 2-6 bar, bearing temperature below 75C, vibration below 4.5 mm/s. Check suction strainer monthly. Maintain oil sight-glass between 50-75%.

title: High vibration / grinding noise
content: Possible causes: bearing wear or spalling, impeller imbalance from erosion, misalignment after overhaul, loose foundation bolts, cavitation from suction blockage. Inspect: measure vibration at bearing housings in three axes, listen with stethoscope, check bolt torque 80 Nm, inspect impeller for pitting. Do NOT run above 7.1 mm/s.
inspection_ref: VIB-CHECK-01: tri-axial vibration reading + bolt torque check.

title: Overheating / low oil
content: Bearing temperature above 85C warrants inspection; above 95C stop the pump and allow cooldown before touching. Possible causes: low oil level, degraded oil, blocked cooling fins, prolonged dead-head operation, worn bearings. Inspect: oil level and colour, cooling passages, feel for hot spots only with IR thermometer (burn hazard), verify suction/discharge valves open.
inspection_ref: LUBE-CHECK-02: oil level, oil sample colour, IR temperature survey.

title: Low discharge pressure / no flow
content: Possible causes: air-locked casing, clogged suction strainer, worn wear-rings, leaking mechanical seal, closed or throttled valve, motor running backwards. Inspect: prime casing, read suction/discharge gauges together, check strainer delta-P, inspect seal drain for drips (more than 10 drops/min means replace). Never throttle suction valve to control flow.
inspection_ref: FLOW-CHECK-03: dual gauge reading + seal drip count.

title: Scheduled service tasks
content: Every 4000 h or 6 months: change oil (ISO VG 46), replace strainer, check alignment with dial indicator (less than 0.05 mm), test standby pump. Record readings in maintenance log. Torque casing bolts to spec.

title: Normal start and load cycle
content: Normal discharge 6-8 bar, sump temperature 70-90C, load/unload cycle every 3-8 min. Long continuous load indicates downstream leak or undersizing. Daily: drain condensate, check belt tension deflection 10 mm per 500 mm span.

title: High discharge temperature trip
content: Possible causes: low oil, clogged cooler, failed thermostatic valve, high ambient above 40C, restricted intake filter. Trip threshold 105C (warning 95C). Inspect: oil level, cooler fins with compressed air (wear eye protection), intake filter vacuum switch, verify ventilation fans running. Reset only after cooldown below 70C.

title: Low oil / oil in air line
content: Possible causes: separator element saturated (more than 4000 h), overfilled sump causing foaming, leaking scavenge line, wrong viscosity. Inspect: sight-glass, sample separator delta-P (more than 0.8 bar means replace), check scavenge orifice for carbon. Top up only with approved synthetic.

title: Low pressure / will not build pressure
content: Possible causes: leaking hose/coupling, stuck inlet valve, worn screw element, faulty pressure switch, belt slip. Inspect: soap-test joints, observe inlet valve stroke during load command, measure motor current vs rated, check belt dust. Isolate receiver before working on lines (stored-energy hazard).
inspection_ref: LEAK-TEST-04: soap test + current draw comparison.

title: Normal cooling performance
content: Supply air 12-16C below return, line pressure 2-5 bar, compressor current within nameplate +/-10%, condensate drain flowing. Replace filters every 3 months; wash coils annually.

title: Insufficient cooling or airflow
content: Possible causes: clogged filter, frozen evaporator from low refrigerant, failed blower capacitor, blocked condenser, thermostat miscalibrated. Inspect: filter light test, coil frost pattern, capacitor microfarad reading, condenser clearance 600 mm, thermostat calibration offset. Isolate power before opening panels.

title: Normal belt tracking
content: Belt runs centred within 10 mm, motor current steady, rollers turn freely, no squeal. Check tracking weekly, clean spillage daily. Nip-point guards must be in place.

title: Squeal, slip, frayed edges
content: Possible causes: under-tensioned belt, seized idler, material build-up on drum, misaligned pulley, overloaded feed. Inspect: belt tension sag 1-2% of span, spin each idler by hand (lockout first), scrape drum, laser-align pulleys, weigh feed rate. Lockout/tagout before touching rollers - entanglement hazard.
inspection_ref: BELT-CHECK-06: tension sag + idler spin + alignment.

title: Motor overload trip
content: Possible causes: jammed material, failed bearing raising friction, incorrect overload relay setting, voltage dip. Inspect: clear chute, megger motor if tripped twice, verify relay setting equals nameplate FLA, log current trend. Reset once; second trip requires electrician.
inspection_ref: DRIVE-CHECK-07: chute, relay setting, current log.

title: Ready-to-start condition
content: Battery healthy, coolant 60-90C when running, oil pressure 3-5 bar, fuel above 75%, block heater energized below 10C ambient. Exercise weekly 15 min under 30% load.

title: Cranks but will not start
content: Possible causes: air in fuel after filter change, dead battery cells, clogged fuel filter, faulty stop solenoid, low coolant lockout. Inspect: bleed fuel to clear bubbles, load-test battery, replace filter if more than 500 h, check solenoid click on start signal, read fault codes before clearing. No ether starting fluid - explosion risk.
inspection_ref: START-CHECK-08: fuel bleed + battery load test.

title: Breaker trips under load
content: Possible causes: overloaded phases, shorted load, failing AVR causing voltage swing, loose busbar heating. Inspect: clamp each phase, compare to nameplate, IR-scan busbars, review load schedule. Never uprate breaker without engineering review.

title: Normal vibration & flow
content: Vibration below 4.5 mm/s, bearings below 80C, belts matched set with equal tension. Grease every 2000 h (2 shots, do not over-grease).

title: Excessive vibration / rumble
content: Possible causes: dust build-up on wheel causing imbalance, loose hub set-screw, cracked blade, soft-foot mounting, resonance at VFD skip frequency. Inspect: clean wheel, torque set-screws, dye-check blades, check soft foot with feeler gauge, review VFD skip bands. Balance weights only by trained staff.
inspection_ref: FAN-BAL-10: wheel clean + set-screw torque + soft-foot.
